timeline: Nine hours after an emergency appeal to save a president in hiding:
this is how Operation Cactus saved the Maldives overnight.
Armed insurgents stormed the island capital of Malé.
President Gayoom hid and made an emergency appeal.
India deployed paratroopers from Agra within hours.
Transport planes flew two thousand kilometers non-stop.
They landed at Hulhule, securing the airstrip instantly.
Soldiers crossed the water and saved the president.
Navy frigates captured the last fleeing mercenary ship.
In just nine hours from the emergency appeal, the nation was saved.
